evidence.claim: Vale's second-quarter 2026 release reports USD 8.8 billion pro forma adjusted EBITDA, USD 4.4 billion pro forma free cash flow, USD 2.4 billion capital expenditure, and USD 15.1 billion expanded net debt.

Vale's Salobo update places coarse-particle flotation in execution, expects first-half 2028 start-up, estimates USD 215 million capital expenditure before USD 40 million of Wheaton funding, and targets up to about 30,000 tonnes of annual copper plus 15,000 ounces of by-product gold.
Vale's 20 August Fundao update states that nineteen additional eligible municipalities joined the agreement, bringing adherence to 45 of 49.

The assessment request exited 2 with no changed paths because assessment source operation was ambiguous for this run; the post-failure security context confirmed that assessment_aca1444a4334b5a06a4f remains current and its research-page hash matches the restored page.
